about: The court evaluation corpus (tests/test_court_eval.gd, harness tests/court_eval/harness.gd). source 'user' = the user's own words from play, exact spelling kept; 'variant' = generated from a case's 'variants'; 'design' = a case the rules imply. 'ideal' is what a good live order reader returns (order_reader.gd schema; $tsaren, $headman... are resolved to ids). Refs: $tsaren $stonefield $eldwick $esurai $home $headman $suri $kavu $imeri $rovik $band. State metrics are listed in harness.measure(); conditions: >0 ==0 ==before <before >before !=before ==b.metric =='text'. Placeholders in text: {metric} after the step, {b.metric} before.
